items.question: What protective and bestowing qualities are attributed to the invoked goddess?
premises: The goddess is called upon to protect.
She is described as having a divine body.
She is described as having a divine essence.
She is characterized as a bestower of enjoyment.
items.inference: The invoked goddess possesses divine nature and the power both to protect and to grant enjoyment.
items.plain_english: May the goddess, divine-limbed, divine-souled, and bestower of enjoyment, protect.
